blocks.tamil_translation: Salah is radiance. Sadaqah is proof, patience is light, and the Qur'an is evidence either for you or against you. If you recite the Qur'an and act according to it, it will be the cause of your success; otherwise, it will become the cause of your being punished,” Hazrat Abu Malik Ash'ari (RA) has narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Just as the impurity of shirk and kufr in the heart is removed by Iman, the impurity of the limbs of the body is removed by Wudu; therefore in this hadith Wudu is said to be half of Iman. Just as light drives away darkness, Salah prevents one from sins and shameful deeds; therefore Salah has been called light. Another meaning: because of Salah, the face of the one who prays will be radiant on the Day of Qiyamah, and in this world too the faces of those who pray will be bright. A third meaning has also been given for Salah: that Salah will be light in the darkness of the grave and of Qiyamah. The meaning of charity being proof is this: wealth is something dear to a person, and spending it in the path of Allah becomes proof that he is truthful in his Iman. The meaning of patience being light is that the patient person, who fulfils the commands of Allah, does not disobey Him, and endures hardships, keeps the light of guidance (Hidayah) within himself.
(Nawawi, Mirqat)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ خَلِيلِي ﷺ يَقُولُ: تَبْلُغُ الْحِلْيَةُ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ حَيْثُ يَبْلُغُ الْوُضُوءُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب تبلغ الحلية... رقم:٥٨٦
